seo.title: Import & International Logistics Services
seo.description: Full foreign trade solutions between Asia and Latin America: supplier sourcing, factory audits, FCL ocean freight, and integrated logistics.

hero.title: Our Sourcing & Import Services
hero.lead: We control every critical link of your supply chain at origin so your cargo arrives at the agreed quality with no surprise costs.
hero.imageAlt: Container ship on a sea route from China to Latin America

catalog.title: Four solutions built for demanding importers
catalog.lead: Hire the full turnkey service or activate only the modules your current operation needs.

process.title: How we work from start to finish
process.lead: A standardized flow with formal approvals at every stage so nothing is left to chance.

steps.label: 1. Technical scoping and source search
steps.description: We receive your requirements, technical sheets, or samples to identify qualified manufacturers.

steps.label: 2. Sample shipping and testing
steps.description: Physical review of finish, tolerances, and packaging before committing production funds.

steps.label: 3. On-site factory audit
steps.description: Inspection of machinery, installed capacity, and the manufacturer's legal background.

steps.label: 4. Pre-shipment AQL quality control
steps.description: Rigorous sampling before releasing the final payment to the Asian supplier.

steps.label: 5. Ocean freight and customs clearance
steps.description: Carrier booking, port coordination, customs settlement, and delivery to your warehouse.

closingCta.title: Have a container in mind, or want to audit a factory?
